entry.content: • (Cloud Storage) Deprecated gcloud storage buckets anywhere-caches pause command.
entry.summary: The 'gcloud storage buckets anywhere-caches pause' command in Cloud Storage has been deprecated. Users should no longer rely on this command for managing anywhere caches.
entry.title: Breaking Changes: Cloud Storage command deprecated

entry.content:
• Deprecated minikube component in Google Cloud CLI. The component will be removed after January 31, 2027. Existing local configurations and clusters in ~/.minikube will be preserved. Minikube is an open-source project and continues to be actively maintained. To avoid disruptions, please migrate to standard OSS Minikube installations: https://minikube.sigs.k8s.io/docs/start/.
  • Upgraded OpenSSL version to 3.5.8 in Linux bundled Python to resolve CVE-2026-42508.
entry.summary: The minikube component in Google Cloud CLI is deprecated and will be removed after January 31, 2027. Users should migrate to standard OSS Minikube installations to avoid disruptions. Additionally, the OpenSSL version in Linux bundled Python has been upgraded to 3.5.8 to address a security vulnerability.
entry.title: Google Cloud CLI: Minikube component deprecated

entry.content: • Added --edition flag in gcloud alloydb clusters create|update for alpha and beta tracks.
entry.summary: The AlloyDB team has introduced a new --edition flag for cluster creation and updates. This flag is currently available in alpha and beta tracks, allowing users to specify different editions for their AlloyDB clusters.
entry.title: AlloyDB: AlloyDB editions flag

entry.content: • Added gcloud apigee apis delete which deletes an API proxy and all of its revisions. Undeploy every deployed revision first with gcloud apigee apis undeploy.
entry.summary: A new command, `gcloud apigee apis delete`, has been introduced to remove API proxies and all their revisions. Ensure all deployed revisions are undeployed first using `gcloud apigee apis undeploy` before executing the delete command.
entry.title: Apigee: Apigee API Proxy Deletion Command

entry.content: • Added gcloud artifacts files upload which allows user to upload Conda packages to a Conda repository.
entry.summary: You can now upload Conda packages to your Conda repositories using the `gcloud artifacts files upload` command. This new feature simplifies the process of managing and distributing your Conda packages within Artifact Registry.
entry.title: Artifact Registry: Upload Conda Packages to Artifact Registry

entry.content:
• Added --cross-cloud-cache to gcloud biglake iceberg catalogs create and update commands to configure cross-cloud cache per catalog.
  • Added --kms-key flag to gcloud biglake iceberg catalogs create and update commands.
  • Added --kms-key flag to gcloud biglake delta-sharing catalogs create and update commands.
entry.summary: BigLake now supports cross-cloud caching and KMS key configuration for both Iceberg and Delta Sharing catalogs. These updates enhance security and performance for your data catalog management.
entry.title: BigLake: BigLake Catalog Enhancements

entry.content:
• Added gcloud backup-dr auto-protection-policies command group in alpha and beta tracks.
  • Added gcloud backup-dr auto-protection-bindings command group in alpha and beta tracks.
  • Added gcloud beta backup-dr binding-matching-resources command group to manage Backup and DR BindingMatchingResources.
entry.summary: New `gcloud backup-dr` commands for auto-protection policies, auto-protection bindings, and binding-matching resources are now available in alpha and beta. These additions enhance the management capabilities for Backup and DR services.
entry.title: Cloud Backup DR: New Auto-Protection Commands for Backup and DR

entry.content:
• Promoted gcloud firestore change-streams commands to beta.
  • Promoted search configuration options to GA for gcloud firestore indexes composite create.
entry.summary: We're excited to announce that `gcloud firestore change-streams` commands have been promoted to beta. Additionally, search configuration options for `gcloud firestore indexes composite create` are now generally available.
entry.title: Cloud Firestore: Firestore commands reach new milestones

entry.content: • Promoted --public-cluster and --allowed-source-ip-ranges flags to GA for gcloud managed-kafka clusters create and gcloud managed-kafka clusters update.
entry.summary: We are excited to announce that the `--public-cluster` and `--allowed-source-ip-ranges` flags for creating and updating managed Kafka clusters are now generally available. This release simplifies the process of configuring secure, publicly accessible Kafka clusters.
entry.title: Cloud Managed Kafka: Managed Kafka Public Clusters Now Generally Available

entry.summary: You can now use the `--tags` flag when creating Memorystore for Redis instances. This feature allows you to add custom metadata to your Redis instances, making them easier to manage and organize. This can be particularly useful for large deployments or when you need to categorize instances for billing or operational purposes.
entry.title: Cloud Memorystore: New tag support for Redis instances

entry.content: • Updated 'cloud-sql-proxy' packaged component to use 2.25.4 of the Cloud SQL Proxy.
entry.summary: The Cloud SQL Proxy has been updated to version 2.25.4. This update includes the latest improvements and security patches for the proxy component.
entry.title: Cloud SQL: Cloud SQL Proxy Updated

entry.content: • API Keys: Added --[no-]check-existing-usage flag to gcloud services api-keys update and gcloud services api-keys delete to verify whether the key has recent incompatible traffic before updating or deleting the key (defaults to true).
entry.summary: New flags `--[no-]check-existing-usage` are now available for `gcloud services api-keys update` and `gcloud services api-keys delete`. These flags help verify recent key traffic before performing updates or deletions, preventing accidental disruptions.
entry.title: Cloud Services: API Key Management Enhanced

entry.content: • Fixed an issue in gcloud cluster-director clusters update help text and documentation where --update-slurm-partitions included an unsupported exclusive flag in examples.
entry.summary: Resolved an issue in the Cluster Director update command's help text and documentation. The unsupported 'exclusive' flag has been removed from Slurm partition examples to ensure accurate guidance.
entry.title: Cluster Director: Cluster Director Update Fix

entry.content:
• Promoted regex_rewrite support in url_rewrite block to GA for gcloud compute url-maps.
  • Added --network-endpoint-group flag to gcloud compute backend-services create command.
  • Added --ha-policy-fast-ip-move flag to gcloud compute backend-services create command.
  • Added --ha-policy-leader-backend-group and --ha-policy-leader-instance flags to gcloud compute backend-services update command.
  • Added --no-graceful-shutdown flag to gcloud compute instance-groups managed stop-instances command across all release tracks.
  • Added --no-graceful-shutdown flag to gcloud compute instance-groups managed delete-instances command across all release tracks.
  • Added --outlier-detection-* flags to gcloud compute backend-services create and update commands to configure outlier detection settings.
  • Promoted gcloud compute recoverable-snapshots recover to beta.
  • Promoted gcloud compute recoverable-snapshots delete to beta.
  • Promoted gcloud compute recoverable-snapshots describe to beta.
  • Promoted gcloud compute recoverable-snapshots list to beta.
  • Promoted gcloud compute recoverable-snapshots set-iam-policy to beta.
  • Promoted gcloud compute recoverable-snapshots test-iam-permissions to beta.
  • Promoted gcloud compute instances get-vm-extension-state to beta.
  • Promoted gcloud compute instances list-vm-extension-states to beta.
  • Promoted enable-vpc-scoped-dns sub-argument of --network-interface flag in gcloud compute instances create to GA.
  • Promoted enable-vpc-scoped-dns sub-argument of --network-interface flag in gcloud compute instance-templates create to GA.
  • Promoted --share-setting flag in gcloud compute reservations update to GA.
  • Promoted gcloud compute project-views describe command to GA.
entry.summary: New features and updates for Compute Engine users include GA for regex rewrite support in url maps, enhanced backend service configurations, and new beta features for recoverable snapshots and VM extensions. Several flags for managing instances and reservations are now generally available.
entry.title: Compute Engine: Compute Engine updates for Compute Engine users

entry.content:
• Added support for updating connectivity options (--private-connection, --psc-service-attachment, --static-ip-connectivity, and forward SSH flags where supported) in gcloud database-migration connection-profiles update.
  • Added --mysql-is-primary-destination flag to gcloud database-migration migration-jobs create command to specify whether the destination for the migration job is a primary instance.
entry.summary: You can now update connectivity options for your database migration connection profiles using the `gcloud database-migration connection-profiles update` command. Additionally, a new flag is available for migration job creation to specify if the destination is a primary instance.
entry.title: Database Migration: Update connection profiles and migration jobs

entry.content:
• Promoted gcloud metastore services migrations start, describe, list, and delete to GA for one-shot migrations (mode:BACKFILL).
  • Added support for INCREMENTAL_SYNC mode in public preview for iceberg migrations.
entry.summary: Dataproc Metastore has promoted one-shot migration commands to General Availability. Additionally, support for incremental sync migrations is now in public preview.
entry.title: Dataproc Metastore: Dataproc Metastore migrations now GA

entry.content:
• Added gcloud design-center spaces application-templates export command to export IaC for an application template.
  • Added gcloud design-center spaces application-templates revisions export command to export IaC for an application template revision.
  • Added --input-variable-aliases, --add-input-variable-aliases, --clear-input-variable-aliases, and --remove-input-variable-aliases flags to gcloud design-center components update to manage input variable aliases.
entry.summary: New commands allow exporting Infrastructure as Code for application templates and their revisions. Additionally, flags have been introduced to `gcloud design-center components update` for managing input variable aliases.
entry.title: Design Center: Design Center: Export IaC and Manage Aliases

entry.summary: This is a release announcement for the developer_knowledge component. It provides updates and changes related to this component.
entry.title: Developer Knowledge: Developer Knowledge Release Notes
